fingerprint.primary_object: imprimitive complex reflection groups G(m,p,n) for small ranks n=2-4 and small parameters m<=6 and their reflection representations

method_summary: Molien-series invariant-degree computation with fake-degree character evaluation and orthogonality-relation replay
problem_statement: Enumerate all 42 triples (m,p,n) with 2<=n<=4, 1<=m<=6, p|m. For each, construct the imprimitive reflection representation of G(m,p,n) over Q(zeta_m) (monomial matrices with m-th roots of unity, product constraint for p>1), compute |G|=m^n n!/p, expand the Molien series M(t)=|G|^{-1} sum_{g in G} 1/det(1-t g) to order t^30 by exact group enumeration (max order 31104), and fit M(t)=1/prod_i(1-t^{d_i}) to recover fundamental degrees d_i. Compute codegrees from reflection eigenvalues and the reflection fake-degree polynomial F_ref(t) for the n-dimensional reflection representation via graded coinvariant multiplicity (character-averaged Hilbert series), evaluated with exact cyclotomic arithmetic. Verify (i) product d_i = |G|, (ii) Molien-coefficient agreement to order 30, (iii) F_ref(1)=n, (iv) full character orthogonality sum_{g} chi(g) conj(chi'(g))=|G| delta on the constructed matrices. Isolate G(4,2,2) (order 16, degrees 4,4) as explicit non-Coxeter splitting witness whose Molien denominator (1-t^4)^2 and reflection fake-degree distribution cannot occur for symmetric groups S_k (distinct exponents 1..k) and diverges from the Coxeter hook-content pattern. Deliver table (m,p,n,order,degrees,codegrees,F_ref(t)) plus Molien-coefficient log, orthogonality matrix, and replay script.
